issues.description: sys.version_info referenced in both mathimpl.py files without a visible import sys in the diff
issues.detail: numba/cpython/mathimpl.py and numba/np/math/mathimpl.py add `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` blocks but the diff shows no `import sys` added. If sys is not already imported at module scope in either file, this raises NameError at import time on every Python version, breaking the modules entirely. Must verify and add the import if missing.

issues.description: Inconsistent Python version gating: sys.version_info in source, PYVERSION in tests
issues.detail: Numba's convention is `numba.core.utils.PYVERSION` for version checks (used in the test), but mathdecl.py and both mathimpl.py files use raw `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)`. Mixing styles makes future Python-version bumps harder to grep and update. Standardize on PYVERSION across all sites.

issues.description: Non-idiomatic Math_unary rebind for exp2 registration breaks class-definition readability
issues.detail: `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` rebinds the module-level class name to the decorator's return value, sitting immediately after the class body with the prior blank line removed. Every other unary math function uses a dedicated `@infer_global` decorator on its own class. Prefer the standard pattern or a clean separate registration call.

issues.description: Release note file missing trailing newline
issues.detail: docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst ends with `\ No newline at end of file`. Numba's towncrier-style release-note tooling and POSIX conventions expect a trailing newline; without it, fragments can concatenate incorrectly when the changelog is assembled. Add a final newline.

issues.description: Test x_values copy-pasted from test_exp with duplicates and no exp2-specific edge cases
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` has duplicated -2 and 2 and is lifted from test_exp. exp2 has meaningful inputs worth covering: 0 (->1), 0.5 (->sqrt(2)), integer powers, large positives (overflow), and special values (inf, nan). Use distinct, exp2-relevant samples.

synthesis.summary: The PR adds math.exp2 support by mirroring the existing math.exp plumbing across docs, typing, cpython/np implementations, and tests, gated on Python 3.11+ via LLVM's exp2 intrinsic. The panel consensus is that the mechanism is correct and minimal but needs cleanup before merge. The most pressing concerns are an unverified `import sys` in both mathimpl.py files (potential NameError at import time), inconsistent version-gating (sys.version_info vs PYVERSION), and a non-idiomatic Math_unary rebind that disrupts the class definition. Lower-priority issues: missing trailing newline in the release note and copy-pasted test inputs that don't exercise exp2-specific edge cases.
